expected_metric: attributable purchases from the tested hook variant
hypothesis: A bounded, reversible test of one change can reveal whether it produces attributable purchases before broader implementation.
observed_problem: Teams often spend months implementing assumptions before testing whether customers value the proposed change.
smallest_safe_change: Run one batch of three verified D1 messages using existing hook variants, then observe attributable purchases during the defined window.
stop_condition: Stop a variant after 20 sends with zero attributable purchases; retain or revise only after a traced sale.
validation_window: 20 sends per variant or 14 days, whichever comes first
why_nebula: Nebula has no validated purchase from the current hook strategy, so a bounded hook test addresses the live acquisition and payment bottleneck.
